Junior Data Analyst - Istanbul
We are looking for a data analyst with 0-2 years of experience. Strong SQL and Excel skills, experience with dashboards (Power BI or Tableau), and the ability to explain insights to non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Python (pandas).
persona: You recently graduated in industrial engineering. You did a 6-month internship in a retail company's analytics team where you built a weekly sales dashboard in Power BI.
